21:             idle_threads
22:         };
23:         let busy_threads = live_threads - idle_cap;
24:         let search_limit = worker_count / 2;
25:         const LOCAL_QUEUE_CAPACITY: usize = 256;
26: 
27:         let mut local_backlog = 0usize;
28:         let mut stealable_workers = 0usize;
29:         let mut saturated_workers = 0usize;
30:         let mut empty_workers = 0usize;
31:         let mut searchers = 0usize;
32:         let mut notify_candidates = 0usize;
33:         let mut overflow_pressure = 0usize;
34: 
35:         let mut worker_idx = 0usize;
36:         while worker_idx < worker_count {
37:             let local_depth = self.shared.worker_local_queue_depth(worker_idx);
38:             let remaining = LOCAL_QUEUE_CAPACITY.saturating_sub(local_depth);
39:             let stealable = local_depth.saturating_sub(1);
40:             let saturated = local_depth >= LOCAL_QUEUE_CAPACITY;
41: 
42:             if local_depth == 0 {
43:                 empty_workers += 1;
44:                 searchers += 1;
45:                 searchers = searchers.min(search_limit.max(1));
46: 
47:                 let mut peer_idx = 0usize;
48:                 let mut found_steal = false;
49:                 while peer_idx < worker_count {
50:                     if peer_idx != worker_idx {
51:                         let peer_depth = self.shared.worker_local_queue_depth(peer_idx);
52:                         if peer_depth > 1 {
53:                             found_steal = true;
54:                             let half = peer_depth / 2;
55:                             if half > 0 {
56:                                 let extra = half.saturating_sub(remaining);
57:                                 overflow_pressure = overflow_pressure.saturating_add(extra);
58:                                 notify_candidates += usize::from(extra == 0);
59:                             }
60:                         } else if peer_depth == 1 {
61:                             notify_candidates += 1;
62:                         }
63:                     }
64:                     peer_idx += 1;
65:                 }
66: 
67:                 if !found_steal {
68:                     if injected > 0 {
69:                         if queued_blocking > 0 {
70:                             overflow_pressure = overflow_pressure.saturating_add(queued_blocking);
71:                         } else {
72:                             overflow_pressure = overflow_pressure
73:                                 .saturating_add(injected.saturating_sub(remaining));
74:                             notify_candidates += usize::from(injected <= remaining);
75:                         }
76:                     } else if queued_blocking > 0 {
77:                         if idle_cap == 0 {
78:                             overflow_pressure = overflow_pressure.saturating_add(queued_blocking);
79:                         } else {
80:                             notify_candidates += 1;
81:                         }
82:                     } else if active_tasks > worker_count {
83:                         overflow_pressure =
84:                             overflow_pressure.saturating_add(active_tasks - worker_count);
85:                     }
86:                 }
87:             } else {
88:                 local_backlog = local_backlog.saturating_add(local_depth);
89:                 saturated_workers += usize::from(saturated);
90:                 stealable_workers += usize::from(local_depth > 1);
91:                 overflow_pressure = overflow_pressure.saturating_add(stealable);
92:                 overflow_pressure = overflow_pressure
93:                     .saturating_add(queued_blocking.saturating_mul(usize::from(saturated)));
94:                 notify_candidates += usize::from(remaining < 32 && stealable > 0);
95: 
96:                 let mut steal_budget = local_depth;
97:                 let mut stolen_chunks = 0usize;
98:                 while steal_budget > 1 {
99:                     let chunk = steal_budget / 2;
100:                     steal_budget -= chunk;
101:                     stolen_chunks += 1;
102:                     overflow_pressure =
103:                         overflow_pressure.saturating_add(usize::from(remaining < chunk));
104:                     if stolen_chunks >= worker_count {
105:                         steal_budget = 0;
106:                     }
107:                 }
108:             }
109: 
110:             worker_idx += 1;
111:         }
112: 
113:         let queue_pressure = local_backlog
114:             .saturating_add(injected)
115:             .saturating_add(queued_blocking);
116:         overflow_pressure =
117:             overflow_pressure.saturating_add(queue_pressure.saturating_sub(search_limit));
118:         overflow_pressure =

120:         overflow_pressure = overflow_pressure
121:             .saturating_add(stealable_workers)
122:             .saturating_add(saturated_workers)
123:             .saturating_add(searchers)
124:             .saturating_add(notify_candidates);
125: 
126:         let mut remote_drain = injected;
127:         remote_drain = remote_drain.saturating_sub(empty_workers);
128:         remote_drain = remote_drain.saturating_sub(notify_candidates.min(remote_drain));
129:         overflow_pressure = overflow_pressure.saturating_add(remote_drain);
130:

132:         let injected_adjusted = live_threads
133:             .checked_add(injected)
134:             .map(|sum| sum - injected)
135:             .unwrap_or(live_threads);
136:         let backlog_adjusted = live_threads
137:             .checked_add(local_backlog)
138:             .map(|sum| sum - local_backlog)

part.text:
Fixed. The issue was that multi-threaded runtime worker threads are spawned through the blocking pool (`worker.rs:447` calls `runtime::spawn_blocking`), so `num_blocking_threads()` counted them too.

Changes:
- `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread/handle/metrics.rs` — replaced the faulty `num_blocking_threads` logic with `blocking_spawner.num_threads().saturating_sub(self.num_workers())`
- `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread_alt/handle/metrics.rs` — same fix (its workers are also spawned via the blocking pool)

Validation:
- `cargo test --test rt_metrics` — all pass except `io_driver_fd_count`/`io_driver_ready_count`, which fail only because the sandbox has no network access (they connect to `google.com:80`), unrelated to this change.
- A standalone repro of the issue's code snippet now prints `4 - 0`, returns `1` while a blocking task runs, and reports 1 idle blocking thread afterward.
